recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, split-composition graphic featuring a complex geometric maze pattern on the left and a high-contrast, dithered mannequin figure on the right, framed by a dashed border and punctuated by primary-colored geometric icons.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical split between a blue-to-grey gradient maze and a solid black field
Contrast between organic-mechanical mannequin form and rigid geometric patterns
Repetition of dashed white lines forming an outer frame
Small primary-colored geometric shapes acting as a focal point near the center-bottom
coreInvariants: Dashed white border around the entire composition
High-contrast black and white photographic element with visible grain
Maze pattern composed of 45 and 90-degree angles
Horizontal red accent lines separating text blocks

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A mannequin figure occupies the right 40% of the frame, scaled to show the torso and upper legs. Text is clustered in the upper-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A large red circle with a white numeral located on the lower right, providing a heavy visual weight against the mannequin.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold top-left text, follow the red horizontal lines, move down the maze pattern to the colored icons, and finally rest on the large red circle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black background behind the mannequin provides high-contrast negative space for the figure to pop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep cyan and black define the background split.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White is used for the border, text, and highlights on the mannequin.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red is used for horizontal rules and the large circular badge.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value white against low-value black, with mid-tone cyan gradients in the maze area.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme horizontal extension for the primary display text
Stencil-like gaps or sharp geometric cuts in letterforms
Uniform stroke weight for secondary text
Condensed proportions for the subtitle text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'E' and 'F' feature elongated horizontal bars with sharp, angular terminals
The 'X' is constructed from two intersecting thick diagonal bars with flat ends
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme width contrast: ultra-wide display text paired with condensed subtitle text.

preserve: Horizontal stretch of the main title
The specific cyan-to-grey gradient in the maze

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the wide, technical feel of the 80s display text
Matches the clean, functional look of the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a split background. Left side: a complex geometric maze pattern in grey over a cyan-to-blue vertical gradient. Right side: a solid black field with a high-contrast, grainy white silhouette of a wooden artist's mannequin. Add a dashed white border around the entire edge. Place three small 3D-effect icons (yellow square, magenta circle, cyan diamond) vertically near the bottom center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in an ultra-expanded white geometric sans-serif at the top left. Below it, add two thin horizontal red lines. Below the lines, add the subtitle in a white condensed sans-serif. Finally, place a large red circle with a bold white number '1' over the mannequin's lower section.

verificationChecks: Is the maze pattern strictly geometric with 45/90 degree angles?
Is the mannequin high-contrast black and white with visible grain?
Are the red lines perfectly horizontal and parallel?
Is the dashed border consistent around all four sides?

adjustableVariables: Specific colors of the small geometric icons
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Sharp, clean vector lines for the maze and border
High-contrast, dithered photographic texture for the figure
Bold, saturated primary colors for accents

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the maze pattern.
Check that the red circle does not obscure critical mannequin details.
Verify the cyan gradient is smooth and vertical.
Confirm the dashed border is perfectly aligned with the frame edges.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a technical geometric pattern with a high-contrast human/mannequin silhouette, using a split-screen layout and primary color accents to evoke 1980s new wave aesthetics.
